name: Ember
summary: A food order card with a spice slider where the chili turns red, shakes and catches fire
about: An order card for a Chicken Karahi with a five-step spice slider. As the heat goes up the chili changes from green to deep red, wobbles faster, starts to sweat and grows flickering flames with rising embers, while the card glows warmer. Add it to the order and a little bowl flies into the cart.
how: Drag the spice slider, use the arrow keys or tap None, Mild, Medium, Hot or Fire
The chili jumps, changes colour and shakes harder at each level; Hot and Fire add flames, sweat and embers
Pick how many with the minus and plus buttons; the price updates
Press Add to see the button spin, a bowl fly into the cart and the badge count bounce
The button shows Added for a moment, then resets for the next order
